facts.text: I am redecorating my living room.
I am looking for advice on what kind of coffee table would complement my new rug.
I scored an amazing deal on my rug from Overstock during their Black Friday sale.
My rug is a plush Moroccan-inspired design.
My rug has a soft blue and cream color palette.
I like the idea of a reclaimed wood coffee table.
I want a wooden coffee table with a lower shelf.
I have a lot of books and decorative items I want to display.
I want to add plants to my living room to purify the air and brighten things up.
I recently picked up a cute little succulent from the nursery down the street.
I planted the succulent in a modern, ceramic planter from Urban Outfitters.
I am thinking of adding more plants to my living room.
I am not sure whether to group my plants together or scatter them around the room.
I think I will group some of my plants together.
I think I will also scatter a few plants around the room.
I have a pretty large living room.
I want to showcase my plush area rug from Overstock with some beautiful plants.

events.text: Overstock Black Friday sale purchase of a plush Moroccan-inspired area rug
